- Kind: core_pipeline

## Contract
`extractSnippets(fileText)` returns `{ snippets: [{name, body, lang}], warnings: [string] }`.

## Seam
bin/tinydoc.js wires fs -> extract -> render -> write.

## Alternatives considered
- Regex whole-file scan vs line scanner: line scanner chosen — preserves order, cheap, easy to warn on unclosed blocks.
